limitations: 835 discovered URL(s) were never fetched (permission, acquisition failure, or budget constraints; out of 885 discovered); findings reflect only the 50 page(s) actually crawled, not the whole site. The sample reached 12 of 18 site sections (first path segment).

Headless browser rendering was not available in this environment; rendering-gap findings are based on a static-content heuristic only and are reported as suspected/insufficient_evidence rather than confirmed.
No external search provider was configured; claim corroboration and off-site footprint assessment were not checked this run (not the same as "nothing found").
1 linked PDF(s) were not fetched (robots rules, a cross-origin redirect, the per-audit cap of 3, or remaining budget; see coverage.non_text_media.pdf_outcomes); their contents were not assessed.

Review and directory platforms (Trustpilot, G2, Google Business Profile and others) were not searched for the brand: they block automated clients, no search provider was configured, and the agent stage (AG-06) was not supplied. Only profiles linked from the site were considered.
Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) were not measured: the audit runs no browser and no PAGESPEED_API_KEY is configured. Web-vitals findings are estimates from markup patterns, not measurements.
Colour contrast and tap-target size were judged only where inline styles set them; colours and sizes from stylesheets need a browser to compute and were not assessed.

confidence.method: min(sample_representativeness, execution_penalty), where sample_representativeness = max(crawl_completeness, min(section_coverage, sample_size)) and crawl_completeness = pages_analyzed / pages_discovered; a weak link caps the score rather than being averaged out. identity_confidence is reported beside the score, not in it: it gates only the checks that depend on the brand's identity

reasons.sample_representativeness: The page sample is small or one-sided: the crawl analyzed 49 of 885 discovered page(s) and reached 12 of 18 site section(s).
reasons.identity_confidence: No Organization markup was found; the brand name was read from the site's own metadata (site name, title suffix or copyright line), which is less certain. Adding Organization markup confirms it.

confidence.explanation: Confidence is medium (0.67). The weaker of its two parts sets the score, here the page sample. The page sample is small or one-sided: the crawl analyzed 49 of 885 discovered page(s) and reached 12 of 18 site section(s). Brand identity (reported separately, not part of the score): No Organization markup was found; the brand name was read from the site's own metadata (site name, title suffix or copyright line), which is less certain. Adding Organization markup confirms it. The score rates how far the report speaks for the whole site; each finding has its own confidence and status, and a problem seen on a page is still real on that page.
